Q: How can I avoid using LLMs as a software developer? A:

How is that relevant?

When you want your house built, you'd only hire workers who use hand tools? Hand saws, not power saws? Hammer every nail by hand, eschewing nail guns? Lug all the shingles up to the roof manually by climbing ladders instead of using a crane?

LLMs in the hands of good developers are de facto an improved search engine that can propose actual solutions that you can then implement.

If you're an incompetent or vibe coder (but I repeat myself...), LLMs are a weapon of mass destruction.

Q: How do I can hide the schema model in Swagger? A:

Hide all controller API 

  @ApiIgnore

Hide selected attribute 

@ApiModelProperty(required = false, hidden = true)

Example : Visible 

@ApiModelProperty(
        access = "public",
        name = "amount",
        example = "123.45",
        value = "the amount - in this example without currency.")
public String getAmount() {
    return amount;
}

Example : Hide

@ApiModelProperty(
       required = false,
       hidden = true
    )
public String getAmount() {
    return amount;
}
